columns.transformation: Parse string/numeric to Decimal(14,2). Never store floats.

columns.meaning: Excel formula: IF(Buying Price==0, 0, Profit / Buying Price)

columns.transformation: Compute: IF(Buying Price == 0, 0, (Profit / Buying Price) * 100). DO NOT import Excel formula.
